parameters.value:
[[Properties, custom, # SHAFT Engine settings for this project (non-secret only).
# Values driven by environment variables (browser, headless, timeout) are also
# applied at run time by support/BaseTest.java, which takes precedence.
targetBrowserName=chrome
headlessExecution=true
browserWindowWidth=1920
browserWindowHeight=1080
autoMaximizeBrowserWindow=false
defaultElementIdentificationTimeout=30
browserNavigationTimeout=30
pageLoadTimeout=60
# Never retry a failed test.
retryMaximumNumberOfAttempts=0
# Healing-like fallbacks are off: a failure must surface, not be worked around.
clickUsingJavascriptWhenWebDriverClickFails=false
screenshotParams_whenToTakeAScreenshot=ValidationPointsOnly
screenshotParams_highlightElements=true
createAnimatedGif=false
videoParams_recordVideo=false
whenToTakePageSourceSnapshot=Never
allure.automaticallyOpen=false
allure.generateArchive=false
allure.accumulateHistory=false
openExecutionSummaryReportAfterExecution=false
telemetry.enabled=false
]]
